'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defence]] claims control over the village of [[Novomykhailivka, Pokrovsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast|Novomykhailivka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-claims-second-gain-two-days-ukraines-donetsk-region-2024-04-22 (Reuters)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] announces its largest ever military support package for the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]], pledging 400 vehicles, including 162 [[International MXT-MV|MXT-MV]]s, 60 boats, 1,600 air defence missiles, 4 million rounds of [[firearm]] ammunition, and an additional £500 million in funding. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/22/rishi-sunak-promises-uks-largest-ever-military-support-package-for-ukraine (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] strikes the [[Kharkiv TV Tower]] with a [[Kh-59]] [[cruise missile]], causing the upper half of the tower to collapse and disrupting the [[broadcasting]] signal in [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/tv-tower-collapses-ukraines-kharkiv-after-russian-missile-attack-2024-04-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Siege of Khan Yunis]]
***[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] and [[tank]]s raid [[Khan Yunis]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] after abruptly withdrawing from the city earlier this month. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-troops-storm-back-into-eastern-khan-younis-bodies-recovered-hospital-2024-04-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in the North Caucasus]]
**Two police officers are killed and another is injured during a [[mass shooting]] of a police squad in [[Karachay-Cherkessia]], [[Russia]]. [https://tass.com/emergencies/1778625 (Tass)]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**Twelve [[Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters]] militants are killed and seven [[Philippine Army|soldiers]] are wounded during a [[shootout]] in [[Datu Saudi Ampatuan]], [[Maguindanao del Sur]], [[Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-bangsamoro-islamic-freedom-fighters-muslim-rebellion-4fc37713c56887dcdc668e809f6d1e89 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Guangdong floods]]
**Four people are killed and ten are missing during [[flood]]s caused by heavy rain in [[Guangdong Province]], [[China]]. Around 110,000 people are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp0gd5ezj9lo (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Japan relations]]
**[[Controversies surrounding Yasukuni Shrine]]
***[[China]] objects to an offering that [[Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Fumio Kishida]] made at [[Tokyo]]'s [[Yasukuni Shrine]] on Sunday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/china-opposes-japan-prime-ministers-offering-yasukuni-shrine-2024-04-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Hamas-led attack on Israel]]
***The head of the [[Military Intelligence Directorate (Israel)|Military Intelligence Directorate]] of [[Israel]] [[Aharon Haliva]] [[resign]]s for failing to prevent the [[Hamas]] offensive on Israel on October 7, 2023. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-hamas-war-news-04-22-2024-85da1c989f71f8c3bf00d8b45a0ed7f1b (AP)]
*[[2024 Maldivian parliamentary election]]
**[[President of the Maldives|President]] [[Mohamed Muizzu]]'s party, the [[People's National Congress (Maldives)|People's National Congress]], is declared the winner of the election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pro-china-party-wins-maldives-election-landslide-media-say-2024-04-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Basilicata regional election]]
**[[Vito Bardi]] is re-elected president of the Italian region of [[Basilicata]]. [https://www.rainews.it/maratona/2024/04/elezioni-regionali-amministrative-balisicata-2024-bardi-marrese-follia-aggiornamento-affluenza-dati-in-tempo-reale-diretta-e3ecdea5-75a8-4db4-af32-4266553b84d6.html (RAI News)]

'''Law and Crime'''
*A [[familicide]] of the Candy family in [[Yukon, Oklahoma]], [[United States]] kills five people including the perpetrator, 42-year-old Jonathon David Candy.[https://www.koco.com/article/oklahoma-murder-suicide-jonathon-candy-family-yukon-ok/60589914 (Koco News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[NASA]] announces that it has received decipherable data from the ''[[Voyager 1]]'' space probe for the first time in five months. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/04/22/world/voyager-1-communication-issue-cause-fix-scn/index.html (CNN)]
